calcprice_embedded_snapshot.note: options.price, no price inputs: lines priced from the embedded snapshot carry source/layer snapshot and snapshot_time == provenance.price_time (structural; values unknown)

calcprice_request_table.note: calc with prices.isk: the price block

gap_bad_override_duplicate.note: BAD_PRICE_OVERRIDE: duplicate target in one list

gap_bad_override_two_targets.note: BAD_PRICE_OVERRIDE: two targets in one entry

gap_delta_ref.note: form 1 delta_ref: deltas against the fit with id s3; no base block

gap_filter_in.note: filter op in (bool list) + not_null; booleans never equal 1/0

gap_filter_in_numbers.note: not_null on delta: every fit has a delta against s5 (incl. s5 itself, delta 0)

gap_filter_not_null_drops.note: not_null drops fits where the field is null/absent

gap_prices_file_map.note: --prices plain map = L4 source injected; one rig unpriced -> missing

gap_prices_file_snapshot.note: --prices eve-price-snapshot v1: source injected, snapshot_time = market_time; overrides stack over it

gap_prices_request_over_file.note: request prices.isk beats the --prices file per type; others still from the file

gap_product_sweep_axis.note: product of two numeric sweep axes

gap_swap_type.note: swap_type replaces every module with type from; no match = unchanged fit

gap_sweep_float.note: float sweep 0..100 step 12.5 (9 values, labels path=value)

gap_sweep_float_inexact.note: float sweep with an inexact step: 0.1, 0.4, 0.7 (from + k*step; to inclusive)

gap_use_snapshot_false.note: use_snapshot false disables L4 (the file): only 2889 priced, the rest missing

gap_use_snapshot_false_fit.note: a FitRequest's own use_snapshot false only affects that fit

multi_duplicates.note: same fits repeated: identical results, order kept

multi_error_in_place.note: an unknown ship type errors in place (error code as one-by-one), neighbours unaffected

multi_filter_sort_2key.note: two filters (AND) + two sort keys (bool desc, then ehp asc)

price_chain_variant_over_request.note: L1 x0.9 over L2 x0.5 over injected (stacked 0.45); fixed L1 stops the chain; deltas on price

price_fit_level_overrides.note: the FitRequest's own price_overrides are layer L2 (request)

price_fits_entries.note: form 1 entries with their own L1 overrides over a batch-wide L2

price_injected_complete.note: injected table prices every item: sources injected, complete, sections sum to total

price_market_group_children.note: market group 9 (Ship Equipment) matches modules in child market groups (deepest-first walk)

price_market_group_deepest.note: parent vs child market groups: the deepest matching group wins

price_missing_list.note: 3 types unpriced -> missing (no_price) with section/index/quantity; not in totals

price_multiplier_without_base.note: multiplier over an unpriced type -> missing reason multiplier_without_base

price_product_options.note: axis options carry overrides (concatenated in axis order = one L1 layer)

price_specificity_order.note: type > market group > group > category within one layer (2889 -> mg 574; 448 -> type; 527 -> category)

price_variant_fixed_beats_request_fixed.note: variant layer beats request layer even when less specific

price_variants_sort_filter.note: variants with their own overrides; filter + sort by price.total_isk; a patched variant with a type missing from the injected table
